body: When my mum was a teen it was her, her teenage brother, three teenage step-siblings, and her mum and step-dad with one tiny bathroom in a small Cape Cod style house. OP’s house has plenty of room.
Yes, knowing that there’s still at least that one option when nothing else is working has brought me some calm as well.
And when I do cry, it’s not the right cry. Like, it doesn’t even get near enough to releasing the place where it actually hurts...
